department: Biomedical Engineering (with the Medical College of Wisconsin)

gre_general.value: MCW no longer requires a test score, GRE or otherwise, for admission; scores are welcome if sent voluntarily.
gre_general.quote: An official test score, GRE or otherwise, is no longer required for admission consideration.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

deadline.value: PhD applicants apply through the Medical College of Wisconsin. Its priority deadline is December 15, 2026; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
deadline.quote: applications accepted by the priority application deadline of December 15 will receive first priority for admission the following Fall

fee_waiver.value: MCW waivers are limited to people with MCW or undergraduate research experience, a GRE fee certificate, or conference attendance.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fee waivers are available to those who within the last three (3) years have:

toefl_min.value: MCW recommends a TOEFL score of 100 or higher; it is recommended rather than a hard minimum.

ielts_min.value: MCW recommends an IELTS score of 6.0 or higher; it is recommended rather than a hard minimum.

english_waiver.value: The English test can be waived for applicants from institutions where English is the primary language of instruction, but only after a written exemption request.
english_waiver.quote: Exemptions may be granted for applicants from institutions where English is the primary language of instruction. | Submit written exemption requests to gradadmissions@mcw.edu after applying.

supervisor.value: Applications are reviewed by a faculty committee, so admission does not depend on a supervisor agreeing first.
supervisor.quote: Review of completed applications from degree seeking candidates is conducted by a faculty committee within the academic program.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students at MCW receive full tuition and a stipend, guaranteed from enrollment through completion.
funding.quote: All full-time PhD degree-seeking students in good academic and professional standing receive the following financial support package: | this package is guaranteed from the time of enrollment through completion of degree requirements

entry_route.value: The page requires a bachelor's degree in engineering, physical science or life science and does not list a master's requirement.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the biomedical engineering graduate programs must have completed a bachelor's degree in engineering, physical science or life science disciplines

notes: The MS is applied for through Marquette's Graduate School. The PhD is applied for through the MCW online application, so the MCW rules above override the Marquette graduate school rules. The Marquette page says the GRE is optional for 2026-2027 MS applicants.
name: Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering
